verdict.tagline: Chaotic cooperative action backed by an incredible soundtrack.
for_you_if: you want a cooperative shooter with deep character variety
you enjoy unlocking items across chaotic runs
you play with friends who host downloadable content
not_for_you_if: you need stable multiplayer servers without connection drops
you are bothered by technical bugs during long runs
you dislike searching for obscured map objectives

cohorts.summary: Players enjoy cooperative sessions and diverse unlocks, though finding map teleporters can prove frustrating and multiplayer servers suffer from crashes.

citations.review_text:
This game's probably an 7/10 for me

I like the tps aspect of it and it's a fairly amazing roguelike. Story is a little lucid and hard to explore, as well as the dlcs aren't that great and actually kinda take away from the game. The unlocking character aspect of it is fun and most of the characters are fun to play, some are obviously better than others though power wise. Feels kinda frustrating having to find the teleporter especially on a couple maps where it's buried in the earth and you can barely see it. As for what I like about it I love the semi open worldness of it and getting to explore breathtaking planets. I also love the item diversity and getting to have god builds, I've had to make charts for items that's how dedicated i am to it. The difficulty levels are nice and balance out in their own way. Although it's much more efficient to speedrun than to get items.

overall, don't buy dlcs except for the custom characters cause those are cool. If you like speedrunning, shooting games that involve racing across planets this is your game.

I think its a very cool game with a cool gameplay loop and many weird hidden mysteries, but it certainly gets a bit annoying and repetitive at times and its hard to get to the EXTRA Interesting stuff!! 7/10

claims.claim: Reviewers mention that the game features a wide variety of items to unlock and collect, though managing them can be overwhelming at first.

citations.review_text:
I'm probably not the target audience for this game, but someone gave me this game for free, and I was pleasantly surprised.

The music and visuals are cool.

Controls and movement are smooth.

You start off with two really solid choices for characters and you get to unlock more later.

If you die while playing multiplayer, you can often pilot a flying drone to stay in the action and help out your friends.

Though, because you won't get the buffs your surviving party members will, you'll probably die quickly, which takes some of the fun out of the game.

So after dying a couple times on a single playthrough, you'll probably want to start over.

I feel like they could've done more to help you compensate for the loss in buffs, but it's not the worst thing to start over either because it's not a super long game.

You can play it solo, but it's certainly better with friends, especially if you're just starting out.

I highly recommend playing your first game(s) with people who've had some experience with the game.

After all, there are a boatload of items to choose from and learn how to use.

There's also a lot going on at all times in the game itself so it can be a tad overwhelming at first, especially playing solo.

Good teammates can certainly carry you till you get used to the game though.

Swapped over from PS5 and decided to repurchase the game and all the DLCs to get familiar with PC gaming, so I have about 300+ hours on the game as opposed to the 8 hours I have through just Steam. This game is fantastic. With friends or solo, you can have fun with it in so many ways. You can let RNG be your guide, you can run a modifier to choose your items and make builds, you can even loop runs until your screen is full of bright colors with glitchy sound effects and you get the "Risk of Rain 2 is not responding" window. The levels have fun designs, the characters all feel significantly different from any other character, and the items are plentiful. It has so many options, you can enjoy this game as a couch casual or a sweat. 100% recommend the game and all the DLCs (up to Alloyed Collective so far).

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features a wide variety of unlockable characters with distinct play styles and alternate abilities.

citations.review_text:
Try it. You'll either love it or hate it.

I personally love it! Graphics are pleasant. Gameplay is addictive, running solo or co-op. Wide variety of (unlockable) characters with different play styles. Lots of neat different worlds, all with their own variations. And if you like to 100%, achievements are challenging but not impossible. I started off playing this on PS4 through PS5 and had a bit over 1200 hours worth over there. Slowly been making the switch to PC (no regrets) and looking forward to racking up more hours, here on PC.

Why this game is a good purchase (The DLCS too)
- The music is amazing and you feel it while playing, even on the annoying maps(looking at you, sundered grove >:( )
- The game has a vast number of items, and a lot of different combinations with said items, allowing for different builds that all do insane damage or insane healing etc.
- The base game itself without the dlcs is fun, but I'd say the dlcs make it better due to map, music, item, and survivor varieties (and if you have friends with the DLC then you don't need to buy that one when playing with them).

Each survivor is unique and fun to play with, I've played all the base characters and they're all well made and fun to play with, especially because they each have alternate abilities to add some nice variety to them.

I got the game for free from a friend, but considering its cheaper than most of the absolute slopfest triple AAA games (like cod,), i'd absolutely recommend it if you were looking to buy a game to play with friends (can play alone, but it is better with friends). 
IT IS A GAME I CAN TRULY CALL VALUE FOR MONEY

claims.claim: Reviewers state that DLC content is shared in multiplayer lobbies, allowing players who do not own the DLC to use its items and characters if the host owns it.

citations.review_text: Overall the base game is pretty fun. The cool thing is that the dlc is shared among the lobby and the dlc adds a good challenge to the game. It gets just as crazy as other bullet hell games like Enter the Gungeon but its in third person. Each character can be pretty overpowered with certain builds and each character is fairly unique in appearance/abilities (Mercenary is the best :P).

Odd looking older game.. well worth the couple of bucks it cost. Music is a sleeper, replay ability high, multi player up to 4 players. Enjoyable for solo as well.. Roguelike FPS game. Addicting with the progression/unlocks, and invite a friend if you get bored. 
Possibly one of the better features if you have a lot of the DLC and host a game, have friends join with only the 'base game' and they can use all the DLC stuff on the run your hosting (no pay walling)
